offering_description.value: Owns and operates post-secondary allied health colleges offering career training programs such as nursing, veterinary technology, and MRI and ultrasound technology. quotes.quote: Meet Legacy Education: nationally accredited, award-winning allied health programs at 4 schools on 6 campuses. Explore our mission, values, and approvals.

Headquartered in Lancaster, California, we proudly own and operate 4 schools on 6 campuses. By offering a wide range of award-winning educational programs, we provide post-secondary students with a marketable path to achieve their professional goals and strive for a legacy of excellence.
